name: revit-mcp-cowork
description: Windows 11-only Codex plugin for safe Revit 2024 automation with bounded local learning from Codex task history.

defaultPrompt: Use $revit-mcp-cowork:improve-revit-plugin to set up the weekly local Revit learning automation using gpt-5.6-sol with medium reasoning.

Plan this Revit change and preview it safely.
